fluxo-social.title: Fluxo Social • CRAS Operational Management (Capstone)
fluxo-social.shortDescription: Modular monolith for social assistance management (CRAS/SUAS) with logical Multi-Tenancy, RBAC, LGPD privacy controls, document verification, and 179 test files.
fluxo-social.description: Social assistance management platform developed as a Capstone Project (TCC) to replace paper records in CRAS units (Social Assistance Reference Centers). Supports complete family case tracking, technical progress notes, benefit approvals, and official RMA reporting.
fluxo-social.challengesTitle: Multi-Tenancy, LGPD Compliance & Sensitive Data Security
fluxo-social.challenges: Modular monolith architecture (Java 21 + Spring Boot 3.4 + 14 Flyway PostgreSQL 16 migrations) implementing logical multi-tenant isolation per unit (cras_id), granular RBAC, and strict LGPD safeguards: native CPF/NIS masking, rate-limited audited reveal actions, magic-byte file upload validation (Apache Tika), and public verification of issued documents.
fluxo-social.impact: Full replacement of paper-based case files with a unified timeline enforcing SUAS confidentiality, automated RMA PDF/XLSX reporting, and extensive automated coverage with 179 test files (61 Java + 118 Vitest) plus 15 ADRs and OpenAPI.
fluxo-social.lessons: Domain modeling for public social assistance with end-to-end auditability, balancing strict LGPD privacy with front-desk usability, and disciplined full-stack automated testing.
stackDetail: Apache Tika, OpenPDF, Apache POI & OpenAPI

conselhos-municipais.title: Municipal Councils • Public Portal & Financial Backoffice
conselhos-municipais.shortDescription: Modernization of a public ecosystem (Institutional Portal + Financial Admin) in PHP 8.2, Slim 3, Doctrine ORM, PostgreSQL 16, and Caixa SOAP/SIBAR billing integration.
conselhos-municipais.description: Ecosystem comprising the Municipal Councils public portal (CMDCA and CMDI) and the administrative/financial backoffice sharing a PostgreSQL 16 database. Manages public notices, news, social entities, approved projects, and tax-deductible donation workflows with bank slip (boleto) issuance and reconciliation.
conselhos-municipais.challenges: Structural upgrade from legacy PHP 7.1 to Dockerized PHP 8.2 FPM with Nginx SSL. Strict compliance with Caixa Econômica Federal's SOAP/XSD schema (SIBAR) for bank slip registration, secure inline PDF proxy preview, automated Cron reconciliation, accessibility toolbar (VLibras, high contrast, font sizing), and PHPUnit test suite.
conselhos-municipais.impact: Reliable continuity and auditability for municipal donation campaigns, reduction of operational errors in bank slip issuance/reconciliation, and improved accessibility for citizens and organizations.
conselhos-municipais.lessons: Safe incremental modernization patterns for production legacy systems, strict XML/SOAP contract validation, and clean separation between public portal and financial backoffice.
stackDetail: Firebase JWT, Reconciliation Cron & 28 PHPUnit files

brisamar-pescados.title: Brisamar Pescados • Catalog & E-commerce
brisamar-pescados.shortDescription: High-performance Web application in Next.js and Tailwind CSS for Box 130 at CEASA Foz do Iguaçu, featuring dynamic catalog and recipes.
brisamar-pescados.period: Commercial Production • CEASA Foz do Iguaçu
brisamar-pescados.description: Brisamar Pescados is a traditional company with over 30 years of excellence in fresh seafood at Box 130 in CEASA Foz do Iguaçu. I engineered a modern, ultra-fast, and responsive web platform serving wholesale clients (restaurants and markets) and retail shoppers alike.
brisamar-pescados.challenges: Built using Next.js with App Router and Server Components for instant load speeds and top Google indexability. Features categorized product filtering, a dedicated culinary recipes section with step-by-step instructions, direct WhatsApp ordering integration, and a modern oceanic aesthetic.
brisamar-pescados.impact: Significant increase in wholesale and retail customer acquisition with direct WhatsApp commercial funnels and instant Server Component page loads.
brisamar-pescados.lessons: Pioneering adoption of Next.js App Router and large-scale image optimization to minimize response times and maximize organic SEO ranking.

fleet-manager.title: Fleet Control System & Python/Redis Worker
fleet-manager.shortDescription: Containerized enterprise system in Laravel 12, MySQL 8, Redis, and a Python Worker (Polars/PyArrow) for yard dispatch, telemetry, and reporting at the Municipality of Umuarama.
fleet-manager.description: Internal system built to manage municipal fleet dispatch, drivers, public yards, and GPS telemetry at the Municipality of Umuarama. Evolved into an event-driven architecture powered by a Redis FIFO queue, a dedicated Python 3.12 worker, and runtime module governance.
fleet-manager.challengesTitle: Laravel + Redis + Python Worker Architecture & Runtime Kill Switch
fleet-manager.challenges: Asynchronous report generation and telemetry analytics processed through a Redis queue consumed by a Python worker (Polars, PyArrow, and XlsxWriter), maintaining high throughput without blocking web requests. Features a runtime module Kill Switch via cache/middleware, return lock, Sanctum auth, JSON technical audit diffs (Spatie Activitylog), and PHPUnit + pytest coverage.
fleet-manager.impact: Non-blocking heavy fleet and telemetry reporting outside PHP, complete JSON audit traceability of system changes, and smooth operation supported by role-based manuals.
fleet-manager.lessons: Decoupling heavy analytical processing via Redis + Python Polars and implementing runtime feature flags/Kill Switches for safe module governance in enterprise environments.
stackDetail: Redis (FIFO Queue) & Python 3.12 Worker (Polars, PyArrow, XlsxWriter)
Docker / Laravel Sail & PHPUnit + pytest suites

jf-informatica.title: JF Informática e Games • Tech Support & Repair
jf-informatica.shortDescription: High-performance static business website built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Tailwind CSS v4 (output: 'export') featuring dynamic Dark/Light Mode and a customer acquisition funnel for PC, laptop, and gaming console repairs.
jf-informatica.description: Digital platform created for a regional tech repair business specialized in computers, notebooks, printers, and gaming consoles. The goal was to establish an impactful, agile online presence with high conversion rates for local clients.
jf-informatica.challenges: Migration of the legacy website to a static export (output: 'export') built with Next.js 16 + React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4, preserving SEO with 301 redirects and LocalBusiness JSON-LD, alongside flash-free persistent dark/light mode and an interactive quote modal routed directly to WhatsApp.
jf-informatica.impact: Professional digital presence in the local Umuarama market with a streamlined quote funnel that boosted technical support inquiries.
jf-informatica.lessons: Modernizing a legacy pure PHP website into a static Next.js 16 export with zero-cost static hosting, preserved SEO authority, and fast page load performance.

bem-digital.title: NGO Hub (Bem-Digital)
bem-digital.shortDescription: Full-featured modular system in Laravel and MySQL for managing donation campaigns, inventory, and donors.
bem-digital.description: Bem-Digital is a comprehensive modular system developed with Laravel (Blade/Alpine.js/Tailwind) and MySQL for managing donation campaigns, inventory control, and donor relations. It enables non-profit organizations to manage donations in real time with transparency and security.
bem-digital.challenges: The project required architecting a complex relational database using polymorphism and pivot tables for a modular Roles & Permissions system. Agile teamwork using Git, Clean Architecture, and Conventional Commits.
bem-digital.impact: Centralization of donation workflows and inventory management for non-profit social organizations.
bem-digital.lessons: Solid architectural structuring of business logic in MVC with strict security validation and data integrity.

bolao-copa.title: World Cup Pool • React Native & Spring Boot
bolao-copa.shortDescription: Mobile app and API built during an academic Hackathon for sports betting and score predictions with React Native and Java Spring Boot.
bolao-copa.description: Mobile client-server solution created in a hackathon coding marathon for sports score predictions during the World Cup. Connects a reactive mobile app to a robust Java backend.
bolao-copa.challengesTitle: Mobile React Native & Spring Boot Integration
bolao-copa.challenges: High-velocity development under tight deadlines: engineering RESTful endpoints in Java with Spring Boot for scoring algorithms, consumed by a React Native interface.

hotsite-unialfa.shortDescription: Academic event portal integrating PHP front-end with Node.js and Java microservices and APIs, currently undergoing continuous refactoring.
hotsite-unialfa.description: Platform designed to manage event portals, registrations, and ticketing workflows at UniALFA. Combines multiple technology layers connecting a traditional PHP front-end to asynchronous backend services.
hotsite-unialfa.challenges: Orchestrating communication between Node.js REST endpoints and auxiliary Java modules consumed by the PHP client. Under active enhancement for future public rollout.

aboutPage.title: About Me
aboutPage.subtitle: Story, learning journey, personal universe, and technologies in practice.

story.title: My Story
story.p1: I am a Junior Full Stack Developer and Internet Systems undergraduate at UniALFA in Umuarama/PR, Brazil. My passion is building clean, efficient, and visually impactful software, bridging backend solidity with modern and accessible user interfaces.
story.p2: My contact with computing began early: by age 12, I was already disassembling computers to understand their internal mechanics. Later on, I worked as a maintenance assistant and IT technician (Mikrotik, Windows Server, and structured networks), acquiring a comprehensive systemic view — from network cabling physics to rendered browser pixels.
story.p3: Across the public and private sectors, I developed high-converting landing pages, corporate systems in Laravel, data ingestion bots in Python, and this portfolio in Next.js 16 with React 19.
story.tributeText: Thank you, Thiago Dalfito. It was your encouragement that brought me into programming, and a part of every project of mine comes from that.

techTimeline.title: Tech Journey
techTimeline.subtitle: How I discovered and evolved in each technology of my ecosystem.

items.title: Hardware, Networks & Mikrotik
items.description: At Imppar (maintenance assistant, Oct/2024 to Feb/2025) I studied and deepened my knowledge of Mikrotik and Windows Server. At Colégio Geração Cima (IT technician, Mar to Oct/2025) I managed computer labs and configured projectors, Apple TV, and Chromecast. Joining municipal IT support, I learned even more about computer architectures and networking from daily operations.

items.title: PHP & Laravel
items.description: Professor Alex Morgado introduced me to PHP in 2024 at UniALFA, and I truly enjoyed exploring various paradigms of the language. I built the first version of the JF Informática e Games website as a pure PHP + JS freelance project (later migrated to a static Next.js 16 export). In municipal support, I was given the opportunity to create a fleet tracking system (Laravel 12, MySQL, Tailwind, Docker/Sail), backed by a Python bot for GPS tracker API data processing. In March 2026, I transitioned internally within the city hall IT department — moving from IT support to systems analysis and development while continuing as an IT intern — taking on Slim Framework projects such as the Municipal Councils systems. I am also continuously refactoring my academic projects.

items.title: Docker & Linux
items.description: After joining the city hall IT department, I adopted dual-boot Linux and started containerizing my projects. Today, I dockerize everything I build for faster, reproducible, and standardized development and deployment.

items.title: JavaScript, TypeScript, React & Next.js
items.description: I have worked with these technologies for 2 to 3 years. I delivered freelance projects and this Next.js portfolio, and React forms the foundation of my bachelor thesis. I also learned React Native, building the Bolão da Copa app during a hackathon at UniALFA in early 2026. I have strong interest in Angular and Vue.

items.title: Python & Data Automation
items.description: Python was the reason I entered programming: my friend Thiago Dalfito encouraged me to learn and watch Gustavo Guanabara's courses. Today, I apply Python for automation scripts, data pipelines, and REST API integrations at city hall.

items.title: Tailwind CSS
items.description: I began using Tailwind in early 2024 and loved it: an intuitive, high-performance styling framework for crafting accessible, dark/light responsive interfaces.
